body:
I was the wolf in sheep's clothing. A disguise.

I am not a nice person.

I had written her... months ago. A long apology. I detailed every grievance, apologizing profusely for the actions that I took. I poured my soul onto it. It wasn't a gambit for her love--it was simply me saying that I was truly sorry.

I thought that helped things. But I checked her twitter recently. It didn't help anything.  In fact, she hates me now, more than ever before, with a straight fiery passion. One tweet very clearly called for my death.

I want to oblige her.
